integrity: Finite numeric verification supplements a general symbolic proof; this is a self-review, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The complete spectrum is correct for exactly the multiplicity-sensitive deletion matrix from Higgins Section 3, not the unweighted incidence relation. The proof uses direct adjoint and commutator identities with orthonormal monomials and a primitive subspace decomposition. Absolute priority against older graded-graph and operator spectral theory has not been established; no independent mathematical audit has occurred.
title: Exact singular spectrum of the balanced multiset-deletion weighting for order-preserving transformations
